mapper.sql: SELECT inventory_balance.*, ROUND(purchaseAveragePrice * balanceQuantity, 2) AS inventoryAmount FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(MAX(material_id), MAX(material_code)) AS uuid, MAX(material_id) AS materialId, MAX(material_code) AS materialCode, MAX(material_name) AS materialName, MAX(model) AS model, MAX(brand) AS brand, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'IN' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END), 2) AS inboundQuantity, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'OUT' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END), 2) AS outboundQuantity, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'IN' THEN quantity ELSE -quantity END), 2) AS balanceQuantity, COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'IN' AND category IN ('PROJECT_PURCHASE', 'CENTRALIZED_PURCHASE') THEN COALESCE(unit_price, 0) * quantity ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'IN' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END), 0), 0 ) AS purchaseAveragePrice FROM goods_transaction_dynamic_info GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(material_code), ''), material_id) ) inventory_balance
